title: The SessionStart intake hook files a finding once, whatever checkout or session starts, and respects the open-draft cap
goal: backlog.py intake --file --hook writes no draft for a fingerprint that an untracked draft, a committed item or a draft set aside under _cache/intake-drafts/ already holds, and writes none while open drafts are over the cap the CLI form enforces; in SP-7y6dk257 the hook re-filed the same three findings 11 times and then 3 more after they were set aside, while intake --file refused them for the 60-draft cap. Retrospective of SP-7y6dk257.
